causal_boundary: current/past account state only; no future return, future price, reward, action label, opportunity score, or market technical indicator

fixed_protocol_assumptions.account_scope: single active traded asset per AccountStatePacketV1; multi-asset portfolio requires a new typed packet version
fixed_protocol_assumptions.max_gross_leverage_contract: fixed/known for a Central Brain run; signed exposure is normalized by it
fixed_protocol_assumptions.max_holding_contract: fixed/known for a Central Brain run; if variable and absolute horizon matters => revision
fixed_protocol_assumptions.timestamp_alignment: all raw account quantities and the referenced MarketSensory packet are as-of the same decision timestamp

principles: no saturating clipping for contract violations

scale_invariances.asset_price_x10: scale current_price and entry_price by same positive factor => payload invariant
scale_invariances.equity_x10: scale equity, peak_equity, signed_position_notional, risk_budget_remaining/capacity, margin_used/capacity by same positive factor => payload invariant
